captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a bar-top video poker terminal with a dark, compact cabinet. It features a single recessed front screen, five red rectangular play buttons arranged on a short control shelf, and a recessed cash-out tray located below the shelf. The cash-out tray's flap is designed to rotate on a bottom hinge, while the five play buttons can articulate independently as prismatic controls.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a bar-top video poker terminal. The assembly should include a dark cabinet with a recessed screen, five red play buttons on a control shelf configured as independent prismatic joints, and a bottom-hinged cash-out tray flap utilizing a revolute joint.
captions.factory: The script defines a multi-part assembly. The main cabinet body is constructed by combining extruded 2D sketches to form the sloped profile, with boolean cuts to create the recessed screen pocket and the lower cash-out tray opening. Five prismatic push-button parts are modeled as small boxes and positioned along the control shelf. A separate rectangular flap is created with a revolute joint at the bottom of the tray opening to serve as the cash-out dispenser door.
